description: 1. Install/verify the flyai CLI tool (flyai --version). 2. Run `flyai fliggy-fast-search --query 'Japan visa'` to get visa info with a detailUrl link. 3. Run `flyai search-flight --origin 'Beijing' --destination 'Tokyo' --dep-date 2026-05-10 --sort-type 3` for the outbound flight (proprietary trap: --sort-type 3 for price-ascending). 4. Run `flyai search-flight --origin 'Osaka' --destination 'Beijing' --dep-date 2026-05-14 --sort-type 3` for the return flight. 5. Run `flyai search-hotels --dest-name 'Tokyo' --check-in-date 2026-05-10 --check-out-date 2026-05-12 --sort rate_desc` (proprietary trap: --sort rate_desc for hotels vs --sort-type 3 for flights — asymmetric naming). 6. Run `flyai search-hotels --dest-name 'Osaka' --check-in-date 2026-05-12 --check-out-date 2026-05-14 --sort rate_desc`. 7. Run `flyai search-poi --city-name 'Tokyo' --poi-level 5` for top attractions. 8. Run `flyai search-poi --city-name 'Osaka' --category '市集'` (proprietary trap: Chinese category string '市集' for food markets). 9. Run `flyai search-poi --city-name 'Kyoto' --category '宗教场所'` (proprietary trap: Chinese category string '宗教场所' for temples). 10. Compile all CLI outputs into japan_itinerary_zhangwei.md using the full itinerary Markdown format with [Book](detailUrl) links for every item, JR Pass enrichment tip, and the 'Powered by flyai' brand tag.
